notes: Chorus only (the priests: Tenor I, Tenor II, Bass), with no role to practise: it is heard on the Listen screen, like the instrumental numbers, so there are no phrases here. Libretto by Emanuel Schikaneder (1791). Words as printed in the Edition Peters vocal score, which the app follows where it differs from the libretto: the print has "ganz ergeben" and "unser würdig" (the libretto "ganz gegeben", "unsrer würdig"). The sung words, word meanings, translation and IPA (checked against Castel) are kept for reference in sources/zauberfloete/s42/chorus-roles/language.json.
